user.title: Configure INIM Prime
user.description:
Choose which backend(s) to use for this panel.

• Native — zones, partitions, arm/disarm, outputs, timers and roller shutters. Fast local polling.
• PrimeLAN — adds scenarios, GSM status, system faults and the event log.
• Both — all of the above (Native is used where it can, PrimeLAN for the rest).

Native only still covers the essentials; PrimeLAN requires the PrimeLAN card and its API key.

serial_number.title: Panel Serial Number
serial_number.description: PrimeLAN cannot retrieve the panel's serial number automatically. Enter it manually.

connection.title: Connect to your panel
connection.description: Enter connection details for your INIM Prime alarm panel.

native.name: Native
native.description: Settings for the Native protocol connection.

data_description.port: TCP port the panel's Native protocol listens on.
data_description.use_outer_frame: Enable if the panel uses a PrimeLAN network card (not the onboard LAN). Set automatically when PrimeLAN is also configured.
data_description.password: Native protocol password. Leave at the default unless you've changed it on the panel.
data_description.use_custom_pin: Enable to authenticate with a specific installer/user PIN instead of the default.
data_description.pin: PIN code used to authenticate with the panel.

primelan.name: PrimeLAN
primelan.description: Settings for the PrimeLAN API connection.

data_description.use_https: Use HTTPS instead of HTTP to reach the PrimeLAN gateway.
data_description.api_key: API key used to authenticate with the PrimeLAN gateway.

data.show_hidden_outputs: Also show outputs not available via PrimeLAN (outputs not available for the linked user)
data.hide_unused_partitions: Hide unused areas (areas with the default name, like AREA 013)

data_description.panel_log_events_fetch_limit:
Number of log events fetched per scan when new logs are detected. Default is recommended.
The integration will automatically fetch more if needed.
data_description.show_hidden_outputs: Native reads every output of the panel, PrimeLAN only those enabled for its user.
data_description.hide_unused_partitions: Areas never named in the panel keep the default name. Enable to hide them and their entities.

scan_intervals.name: Scan intervals
scan_intervals.description: Controls how often Home Assistant sends API requests to the panel (lower values increase traffic). For details on which entities each interval affects, see the integration README.

data_description.zones: How often Home Assistant sends API requests to fetch zone status.
data_description.partitions: How often Home Assistant sends API requests to fetch partition status.
data_description.gsm: How often Home Assistant sends API requests to fetch GSM status.
data_description.system_faults: How often Home Assistant sends API requests to fetch system faults.
data_description.panel_log_events: How often Home Assistant sends API requests to fetch new panel log events.
data_description.outputs: How often Home Assistant reads the outputs status.
data_description.scenarios: How often Home Assistant reads which scenario is active.

alarm_panel.name: Alarm panel
alarm_panel.description: Scenario number (0-49) the panel activates for each command. Leave empty to hide a command; without a disarm scenario the panel is not created.

debug_read_terminals.name: Debug: read terminals
debug_read_terminals.description: Native protocol: raw status (10 bytes) of each terminal, with its label.

debug_watch_terminals.name: Debug: watch terminals
debug_watch_terminals.description: Native protocol: poll terminals for a while and return every raw status change.

debug_read_memory.name: Debug: read memory
debug_read_memory.description: Native protocol: read raw panel memory.

debug_raw_command.name: Debug: raw command
debug_raw_command.description: Native protocol: send a raw command. Can change the panel state: use with care.

debug_memory_diff.name: Debug: memory diff
debug_memory_diff.description: Native protocol: read a memory block and list the bytes changed since the previous call (snapshot=true only stores it).

snapshot.name: Snapshot only
snapshot.description: Only store the block, without comparing.

debug_write_memory.name: Debug: write memory
debug_write_memory.description: Native protocol: write raw bytes to panel memory, like Prime/STUDIO does. Changes the panel: use with care.

session.name: Programming session
session.description: Wrap the write in the begin/end commands Prime/STUDIO sends.

debug_probe_commands.name: Debug: probe commands
debug_probe_commands.description: Native protocol: send plain commands (operation + data, no PIN) and return the answers. Unknown commands may change the panel: use with care.

data.name: Data
data.description: Data bytes as hex, sent with every operation.
